articleBodyHtml:
A Cozy Welcome

The speaker suggests going somewhere comfortable, inviting the listener to hang out. This sets a relaxed and friendly tone for the conversation.

The speaker mentions going to Advent, a place that is a bit far from their castle. This indicates that the journey might be a bit of an adventure.

To ensure they arrive on time, the speaker rented out a room for a bit. This shows their preparation and effort to make the trip manageable.

The speaker warmly welcomes the listener to their room, describing it as cozy. This creates a welcoming atmosphere and highlights the comfort of the space.

The speaker greets the listener and invites them to explore the room, offering a chance to take a look around. This further emphasizes the hospitality and openness of the speaker.
